header.running_head: The Sahabah (RA) See Each other in their Dreams

blocks.text: Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) Sees Nabi ﷺ in a Dream

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) reports, "In my afternoon sleep, I saw Rasulullaah ﷺ with dishevelled hair and with a glass in his hand. 'What is this glass for?' I asked. 'The blood of Husayn (RA) and his companions. I have been picking it up all day.' When we then saw the date, we found it to be the same day in which Husayn (RA) was martyred."[^1]
The Sahabah (RA) See Each other in their Dreams
Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) and his son Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) see Hadhrat Umar (RA) in their Dreams

Hadhrat Abbaas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) says, "I was the neighbour of Umar bin Khattaab (RA) and have never seen anyone better than him. His nights were spent in salaah and his days were spent fasting and tending to the needs of people. When he passed away, I asked Allaah to show him to me in a dream. In a dream one night I saw him coming form the marketplace of Madinah with his shawl draped over his neck. After exchanging greetings, I asked, 'How are you?' 'I am well,' he replied. 'What did you find?' I asked further. He replied, 'My reckoning is now over. Had I not found a Merciful Rabb, my honour would have fallen.'"[^2]

Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) relates, "Umar bin Khattaab (RA) was my very good friend. After he passed away, I made du'aa to Allaah for a complete year to show me Umar (RA) in a dream. The year had just come to an end when I saw him wiping perspiration from his forehead. 'O Ameerul Mu'mineen!' I said, 'How did your Rabb treat you?' 'My reckoning is now over,' he replied, 'Had I not found a Forgiving and Merciful Rabb, I would have fallen in honour.'"[^3]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) says, "I made du'aa to Allaah for a year to show me Umar bin Khattaab (RA) in a dream. When I saw him in a dream, I asked, 'How was your experience?' He replied, 'I found a Most Forgiving and Merciful Rabb. Had it not been for His mercy, I would have fallen in honour.'"[^4]
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) and an Ansaari see Hadhrat Umar (RA) in a Dream
